answer: What survives to the nebula is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, slashed on a failed audit, no identity may audit its own recruit. The horizon lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the garden is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
